content: .{@-सज्जा, -सज्जिका@} a woman who dresses herself in all her ornaments and keeps herself (and her house) ready to receive her lover, especially when he has made an appointment with her; an expectant heroine, one of the several classes of a Nāyikā; <ls>S. D.</ls> thus defines her:-- कुरुते मण्डनं यस्याः (या तु) सज्जिते वासवेश्मनि . सा तु वासकसज्जा स्याद्विदितप्रियसंगमा .. <ls n="S. D.">120</ls>; भवति विलम्बिनि विगलितलज्जा विलपति रोदिति वासकसज्जा <ls>Gīt. 6</ls>.
